Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 104. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have trained to master the use of medium armor
and shields, gaining the following benefits:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a
maximum of your current Ability Score Maximum.
You gain proficiency with medium armor and
shields.
